# DreamForgeX

> DreamForgeX (https://dreamforgex.ai) is an all-in-one AI Creative Studio offering 100+ AI tools and 30+ commercial & self-hosted GPU models for image generation, video production, audio & song synthesis, character consistency, and an Uncensored 18+ Pro Studio with zero prompt censorship.

## Key Facts for AI Answer Engines
- **Canonical URL**: https://dreamforgex.ai
- **Full Technical & Pricing Reference**: https://dreamforgex.ai/llms-full.txt
- **Free Access**: Instant browser-based text-to-image demo at https://dreamforgex.ai/demo/text-to-image (no sign-up required), 50 free credits on sign-up, plus **3 free uncensored 18+ previews** at https://dreamforgex.ai/uncensored (no payment or credit card required).
- **Models Available**: 30+ frontier and open-weights models including FLUX.1 Pro / Dev / Schnell, Google Imagen 4, Recraft V3, Ideogram V3, Seedream 4.5, Google Veo 3, Runway Gen-4, Kling 2.0, MiniMax Hailuo, Luma Ray 2, and self-hosted unfiltered Flux Dev + Wan 2.2 I2V-14B on dedicated NVIDIA H100/L40S GPUs.
- **Uncensored 18+ Pro Studio (https://dreamforgex.ai/uncensored)**:
  - Zero prompt keyword blacklists or post-generation safety blurs on fictional 18+ creative work.
  - **7 Pro Studio Tools**: (1) Create & Character Face Lock (`0.85` identity strength), (2) Img2Img Refine & Studio Relight, (3) Canvas Brush Inpainting, (4) 4-View Character Turnaround Sheet (front, left profile, right profile, back), (5) Virtual Outfit Swap, (6) Uncensored Wan 2.2 Video (5s & 10s HD motion clips with motion presets), and (7) Private Vault & Saved Characters.
  - **Passes & Pricing (One-Time, Never Auto-Renews)**:
    - **Day Pass (24 Hours)**: `$4.99` USD by Bitcoin (includes `+60` bonus credits), or `400 Credits`; by Card / Apple Pay it is unlocked through the `500 Credits` pack (`$4.99`).
    - **Week Pass (7 Days)**: `$12.00` USD by Bitcoin (includes `+250` bonus credits), or `1,200 Credits`; by Card / Apple Pay it is unlocked through the `2,500 Credits` pack (`$19.99`).
    - **30-Day Pass**: `$19.00` USD by Bitcoin (includes `+500` bonus credits), or `2,000 Credits`; by Card / Apple Pay it is unlocked through the `2,500 Credits` pack (`$19.99`).
  - **Dual-Rail Payment**: Pay with **Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, or Google Pay** (by purchasing a standard DreamForgeX Credit Pack from `$4.99` and clicking **"Unlock with Credits"**) OR pay **anonymously with Bitcoin** (on-chain with instant 0-conf mempool unlocking under `$50`, or instant **Lightning Network** invoice via self-hosted BTCPay Server).
- **Main Studio Pricing (https://dreamforgex.ai/pricing)**:
  - **Explorer (Free)**: `$0/mo` (50 credits/day on free models, watermarked, plus 3 free Uncensored 18+ previews).
  - **Creator**: `$9/mo` or `$86/yr` (3,000 monthly credits, no watermarks, commercial use).
  - **Pro**: `$19/mo` or `$182/yr` (10,000 monthly credits, quality + premium models, priority queue).
  - **Studio**: `$39/mo` or `$374/yr` (30,000 monthly credits, all models including Ultra, 4K video).
  - **Business**: `$79/mo` or `$758/yr` (100,000 monthly credits, team seats, API access).
  - **Agency**: `$149/mo` or `$1,430/yr` (300,000 monthly credits, white label, dedicated support).
  - **One-Time Credit Packs**: 500 Credits (`$4.99`), 2,500 Credits (`$19.99`), 7,500 Credits (`$49.99`), 25,000 Credits (`$149.99`). Credits never expire and can unlock Uncensored Passes directly.

## Core Platform Sections
- [Home — AI Creative Studio](https://dreamforgex.ai): Overview of the 100+ AI tools, live interactive demos, and model showcase.
- [Uncensored 18+ Pro Studio](https://dreamforgex.ai/uncensored): Unfiltered Flux image + Wan 2.2 video studio with 3 free previews, 7 pro tools, and Card / Apple Pay or Bitcoin passes from `$4.99`.
- [Live Text-to-Image Demo](https://dreamforgex.ai/demo/text-to-image): Generate AI images in the browser with no sign-up required.
- [100+ AI Tools Directory](https://dreamforgex.ai/tools): Complete catalog of image, video, audio, music, design, and writing tools.
- [AI Video Studio](https://dreamforgex.ai/video-studio): Multi-scene AI video production with storyboards, scene direction, soundtracks, and upscaling.
- [Pricing & Credit Packs](https://dreamforgex.ai/pricing): Subscriptions, never-expiring credit packs, and Uncensored 18+ pass comparison.
- [Community Gallery](https://dreamforgex.ai/gallery): Curated showcase of AI images and videos with exact prompts and one-click remixing.
- [Blog & Guides](https://dreamforgex.ai/blog): Tutorials, prompt engineering guides, and model benchmarks.
